name: lookup_book
description:
Look up a book in the library catalog.

:param code: ISBN-13 of the book, thirteen digits such as 9780306406157.
:type code: str
:returns: The catalog record.
:rtype: dict

name: lookup_product
description:
Look up an item in the store inventory.

:param code: Store SKU in the form AB-1234.
:type code: str
:returns: The inventory record.
:rtype: dict

name: lookup_paper
description:
Look up a published research paper.

:param code: DOI of the paper, starting with '10.', such as 10.1038/nphys1170.
:type code: str
:returns: The paper's metadata.
:rtype: dict

name: cpu_stats
description:
Report processor load for a server.

:param host: Hostname of the server.
:type host: str
:param window_minutes: Averaging window in minutes: 1, 5 or 15.
:type window_minutes: int
:returns: Load average over the window.
:rtype: float

name: memory_stats
description:
Report RAM consumption for a server.

:param host: Hostname of the server.
:type host: str
:param include_swap: Also report swap / page-file usage.
:type include_swap: bool
:returns: Used and free memory in MiB.
:rtype: dict

name: disk_stats
description:
Report storage use for a server.

:param host: Hostname of the server.
:type host: str
:param mount: Mount point or drive to inspect, such as /var or C:.
:type mount: str
:returns: Used and free bytes on the mount.
:rtype: dict

name: send_email
description:
Deliver a written message to a person.

:param recipient: Email address such as name@example.com.
:type recipient: str
:param text: Message body.
:type text: str
:returns: Delivery id.
:rtype: str

name: send_sms
description:
Deliver a short text message to a person's phone.

:param recipient: Phone number in E.164 form such as +14155550123.
:type recipient: str
:param text: Message body, at most 160 characters.
:type text: str
:returns: Delivery id.
:rtype: str

name: post_message
description:
Post a message to a team chat space.

:param recipient: Channel name beginning with '#', such as #ops.
:type recipient: str
:param text: Message body.
:type text: str
:returns: Message permalink.
:rtype: str

name: upload_file
description:
Copy a local file to cloud object storage.

:param path: Local path of the file.
:type path: str
:param bucket: Name of the S3 bucket to copy into.
:type bucket: str
:returns: Object URL.
:rtype: str

name: attach_file
description:
Attach a file to a support ticket.

:param path: Local path of the file.
:type path: str
:param ticket_id: Ticket key such as SUP-1042.
:type ticket_id: str
:returns: Attachment id.
:rtype: str

name: share_file
description:
Create a shareable download link for a file.

:param path: Local path of the file.
:type path: str
:param expires_hours: Hours until the link stops working.
:type expires_hours: int
:returns: The link.
:rtype: str

name: create_event
description:
Add an entry to the shared calendar.

:param title: Event title shown to attendees.
:type title: str
:param start: ISO-8601 start time.
:type start: str
:param attendees: Email addresses to invite.
:type attendees: list[str]
:returns: Event id.
:rtype: str

name: set_reminder
description:
Schedule a personal notification.

:param text: What to remind about.
:type text: str
:param at: ISO-8601 time at which the notification fires.
:type at: str
:returns: Reminder id.
:rtype: str

name: block_focus_time
description:
Reserve uninterrupted time on your own schedule.

:param start: ISO-8601 start time.
:type start: str
:param duration_minutes: Length of the block in minutes.
:type duration_minutes: int
:param mute_notifications: Silence all notifications during the block.
:type mute_notifications: bool
:returns: Block id.
:rtype: str

name: convert_currency
description:
Convert an amount between currencies.

:param amount: Amount to convert.
:type amount: float
:param source: ISO 4217 code of the source, such as EUR.
:type source: str
:param target: ISO 4217 code of the target, such as JPY.
:type target: str
:returns: Converted amount.
:rtype: float

name: convert_units
description:
Convert a measurement between units.

:param amount: Value to convert.
:type amount: float
:param source: Unit symbol of the source, such as km, lb or degF.
:type source: str
:param target: Unit symbol of the target.
:type target: str
:returns: Converted value.
:rtype: float

name: convert_timezone
description:
Convert a clock time between time zones.

:param amount: Clock time to convert, such as 14:30.
:type amount: str
:param source: IANA zone name of the source, such as Europe/Paris.
:type source: str
:param target: IANA zone name of the target.
:type target: str
:returns: Converted clock time.
:rtype: str
